thread:
emily_cs: FYI looping everyone in — LatticeHealth confirmed 10 seats for our pilot starting next week. Need to lock in onboarding cadence + weekly feedback checkpoints.

matt_pm: Great — can we do their enablement + integration review on Mon? they said devs are free afternoons PST.

jessica_cs: monday afternoon works for me. should we run a short success plan doc first so they know outcomes? i can draft a 1-pager.

oliver_eng: tagging in on integration. curious about dataflow — are they sending batched patient records via SFTP or streaming?

emily_cs: they have an SFTP export today but are open to switching to secure API. Kara, do we have a secure-upload quickstart we can share?

kara_cs: yes — sending link to quickstart and sample config in the call: https://redwood/internal/quickstarts/lattice-sftp-to-api (share after this thread) :paperclip:

matt_pm: for risk: finance flagged that LatticeHealth wants a 6-month SLA trial and an early discount. we should track renewal risk if usage < 20% of seats during month 1. recommend weekly cadence to catch adoption drops.

jessica_cs: agreed — i'll add a KPI section to the 1-pager: seat activation %, avg weekly queries per seat, top error types. will include beacons for early-warning.

oliver_eng: for onboarding ops: suggest a small canary rollout — enable 2 seats first with full logging so we can verify prompt/response latency and edge cases. if OK, open rest.

emily_cs: love that. can we schedule the canary window Tue-Wed with a rollback plan?

oliver_eng: yep. draft rollback: revert to batch SFTP export and pause real-time endpoints (30m window). i'll post the exact curl + env snippet in the call.

matt_pm: booking: Mon 2:30pm PST for enablement + Tue 10am PST for canary kick. invites sent to their team.

jessica_cs: for capture: i'll set up a shared Google doc for feedback + attach the short survey we'll push after week 1. also will add a Slack channel for LatticeHealth <> CS <> Eng triage.

emily_cs: perfect. action items: 1) jessica: 1-pager + feedback doc (due EOD today) 2) oliver: rollback + curl snippet (due Mon morning) 3) kara: quickstart link + sample config in hand for call 4) matt: confirm invites (done).

oncall-bot: Reminder: please tag #eng-oncall for any production-impacting incidents.

matt_pm: one more — legal asked for data-handling summary for their compliance team. Kara, can you attach our DPIA + SOC notes?

kara_cs: yes, uploading DPIA excerpt and SOC2 summary to the shared folder now.

emily_cs: thanks team. i'll run the enablement call notes and share a short public pulse at end of week. if anyone sees early drop in seat activation i'll ping here. :rocket:
